contingency_situation: Delayed Monsoon Onset by 2-3 Weeks (Sowing Window Shifted to Mid-July)
target_region_and_crops: Telangana & Andhra Pradesh: Cotton, Maize, Groundnut
contingency_action_plan: Continue with normal cotton hybrids until July 15. If sowing delayed beyond July 15, switch to short-duration cotton or alternate crops like Maize (DHM 117), Soybean, or Red Gram.
Adopt Broad Bed and Furrow (BBF) or ridge-furrow planting to conserve rainwater.
Seed treatment with biofertilizers (Azotobacter and PSB) to accelerate early root establishment.
scientific_rationale: Late-sown cotton experiences terminal drought and bollworm flare-up during flowering; switching to maize or soybean maintains farm profitability.

contingency_situation: Severe Monsoon Delay by 4-6 Weeks (No Sowing Till August 1st Week)
target_region_and_crops: Deccan Plateau & Central India Drylands: Rainfed Tracts
contingency_action_plan: Completely abandon Cotton, Groundnut, and Soybean for rainfed tracts.
Switch to ultra-short duration contingency crops: Sunflower (DRSF 108), Castor (DCH 519), Pearl Millet (Bajra ICTP 8203), Green Gram (Mung WGG 42), Horse Gram (Ulavalu), or Fodder Sorghum.
Reduce seed rate by 15-20% and increase inter-row spacing to minimize canopy water competition.
scientific_rationale: Short-duration oilseeds and pulses mature within 65-80 days using remaining post-monsoon soil moisture.
authoritative_source: ICAR-CRIDA National Contingency Plan for Agricultural Drought 2025

contingency_situation: Mid-Season Drought / Dry Spell of 20-25 Days During Vegetative Stage (August)
target_region_and_crops: All Rainfed Crops (Cotton, Soybean, Red Gram, Groundnut)
contingency_action_plan: Perform shallow intercultural harrowing (dust mulching) to break surface capillary pores and arrest evaporation.
Spray anti-transpirants: Foliar spray of 2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 20 g/L) or 1% Urea to maintain leaf cell turgor.
Remove alternate rows of crop for fodder if extreme drought threatens total crop desiccation.
Apply life-saving supplemental irrigation through micro-sprinklers from farm ponds (Krishi Honda).
scientific_rationale: KNO3 spray induces partial stomatal closure, reducing transpiration while supplying vital potassium for osmotic adjustment.

contingency_situation: Terminal Drought / Early Monsoon Withdrawal During Reproductive Stage (September-October)
target_region_and_crops: Kharif Rainfed Crops: Cotton, Red Gram, Maize
contingency_action_plan: Give single life-saving irrigation at flowering/pod set from harvested farm pond water.
Foliar spray of 2% DAP (20 g/L) + 1% Potassium Chloride (MOP 10 g/L) in evening hours.
Harvest maize for green fodder or cob silage if grain formation is severely impaired.
scientific_rationale: Direct nutrient feeding through leaf stomata bypasses dried-up root zone where nutrient uptake has halted.

contingency_situation: Flash Floods & Waterlogging in Standing Kharif Crops (August-September)
target_region_and_crops: River basins & canal command areas: Rice, Cotton, Maize
contingency_action_plan: Drain standing flood water from fields within 24-48 hours by opening drain cuts.
Once water drains, apply a booster foliar spray of 19:19:19 @ 10 g/L + Urea @ 10 g/L to revive root respiration and nitrogen assimilation.
Drench collar region with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L to prevent secondary fungal collar rots in cotton/vegetables.
Top dress 25 kg Urea + 15 kg MOP per acre after 4-5 days of drainage.
scientific_rationale: Waterlogged roots suffer acute oxygen starvation (hypoxia); foliar nutrients supply immediate sustenance until roots resume aeration.

contingency_situation: Unseasonal Rainfall at Paddy Harvest Time (November-December)
target_region_and_crops: Coastal Andhra, Telangana, Odisha: Rice / Paddy
contingency_action_plan: Spray 5% common salt solution (NaCl @ 50 g/L) on mature standing panicles or harvested sheaves to prevent grain germination.
Stack harvested sheaves with panicles pointing inwards and covered with tarpaulin.
Shift harvested produce to community solar poly-dryers or WDRA warehouse drying floors.
scientific_rationale: Common salt solution dehydrates grain husk surface, creating osmotic barrier that inhibits viviparous embryo germination.

contingency_situation: Severe Heatwave during Rabi Wheat Flowering & Grain Filling (March)
contingency_action_plan: Provide light evening irrigations through sprinklers to maintain micro-environment canopy humidity.
Spray 0.2% Potassium Nitrate (2 g/L) or 0.2% Salicylic acid (200 ppm) at boot and anthesis stages.
Avoid full flood irrigation during afternoon winds to prevent massive lodging.
scientific_rationale: Exogenous salicylic acid and potassium stimulate antioxidant enzyme activity, detoxifying reactive oxygen species (ROS).
authoritative_source: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Terminal Heat Mitigation Protocol 2025

contingency_situation: Sudden Fall Armyworm (FAW) Surge in Maize Whorls
target_region_and_crops: Telangana, Karnataka, Bihar, MP: Kharif & Rabi Maize
contingency_action_plan: Apply neem cake powder or dry soil/sand mixed with ash (9:1 ratio) directly into central leaf whorls.
Release egg parasitoid Telenomus remus @ 40,000/acre.
If whorl damage exceeds 10%, spray Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 80 ml/acre (6 ml per 15L pump) directed into whorl funnel using single nozzle.
scientific_rationale: Physical abrasive action of sand/ash disrupts caterpillar cuticle, while targeted chemical drenching reaches hidden larvae.
authoritative_source: DPPQS & ICAR-IIMR Fall Armyworm Action Advisory 2025

contingency_situation: Pink Bollworm Flare-up in Bt Cotton (Exceeding 8 moths/trap/night)
contingency_action_plan: Pluck and destroy rosette flowers containing larvae manually twice a week.
Install 8-10 pheromone traps/acre for mass annihilation.
Foliar spray of Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L pump) or Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram) @ 170 ml/acre in evening.
Strictly terminate crop by December 31; DO NOT extend crop into ratoon or fourth picking.
scientific_rationale: Terminating crop by December starves the overwintering diapause larvae, breaking pest cycle for succeeding season.

contingency_situation: Ground Frost / Cold Wave Threat in Rabi Potato & Mustard (January)
target_region_and_crops: Northern India Plains: UP, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan
contingency_action_plan: Give light evening irrigation to raise soil heat content.
Smudging (smoke generation) around field borders on north-west windward side.
Spray 0.1% Thiourea (1 g/L) or 0.1% Sulphuric acid on foliage.
scientific_rationale: Warm smoke cloud acts as thermal blanket reflecting radiant infrared terrestrial heat back to crop canopy.

contingency_situation: High Canal Water Deficit in Rabi Season (Tail-End Canal Command)
contingency_action_plan: Replace high water-requiring Rabi Paddy (1200 mm) with dryland Irrigated Dry (ID) crops: Groundnut (450 mm), Chickpea (250 mm), Maize (500 mm), or Black Gram (300 mm).
Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) if paddy has already been transplanted.
scientific_rationale: ID crops require 60-75% less water than flooded paddy and generate higher net return per unit water consumed.

contingency_situation: Acute Fertilizer Shortage / High Urea Price Shock
contingency_action_plan: Replace 25% chemical urea with Nano Urea (liquid) foliar spray @ 4 ml/L at active tillering and panicle initiation.
Use Neem Coated Urea (NCU) with split application (3 splits) to minimize leaching and volatilization loss.
Incorporate biofertilizers (Azotobacter, Azospirillum, PSB) @ 1 kg/acre mixed in FYM.
scientific_rationale: Nano Urea has >80% nitrogen use efficiency compared to 30-40% for conventional granular urea.
authoritative_source: Ministry of Agriculture & IFFCO Nano Urea Guidelines 2025

contingency_situation: Hailstorm Damage in Fruiting Vegetables & Onions (February-March)
target_region_and_crops: Maharashtra, MP, Telangana: Tomato, Chilli, Onion
contingency_action_plan: Remove broken, smashed branches and rotting fruits immediately.
Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L within 24 hours to prevent wound pathogens.
Apply foliar spray of micronutrients + 1% Urea to stimulate new lateral branching.
scientific_rationale: Hail cuts create open infection courts for Alternaria and bacterial rots; copper bactericide seals torn margins.

contingency_situation: Sudden Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) Outbreak in Booting Paddy
target_region_and_crops: Telangana, AP, Punjab, Haryana: Rice / Paddy
contingency_action_plan: Drain standing water completely from field for 3-4 days to expose base of hills to sunlight and air.
Form alleys (walking pathways) by parting plant hills every 8-10 rows.
Spray Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L pump) or Token 20% SG (Dinotefuran) @ 100 g/acre directed strictly at plant bases.
scientific_rationale: Drying field breaks humid microclimate required for hopper nymph development.

contingency_situation: Terminal Heat & Rust Surge in Late Sown Wheat
contingency_action_plan: Spray Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) at first appearance of stripe rust pustules.
Spray 0.2% Potassium Nitrate at milking stage.
Maintain light soil moisture with frequent shallow irrigations.
scientific_rationale: Propiconazole halts urediniospore germination, while potassium strengthens cell wall thickness against drought/heat.
authoritative_source: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Wheat Rust & Heat SOP 2025
